uncertain.why: Bare Vierstra token spanning AC0631:ATF/CREB (CRE) and AC0456:ATF/ATF6B (ERSE-like); placed on the shared TGACGTCA CRE core.
Bare token traced to Vierstra archetype AC0665:BCL/BCL6B, i.e. the BCL6/BCL6B STAT-like site, not BCL11.
Bare token traced to Vierstra AC0066:USF/BHLHE, a CACGTG E-box archetype, so DEC1/DEC2 rather than BHLHE22/23.
SWI/SNF BAF250a; its ARID domain binds DNA without sequence specificity, so it should not join the ARID3/ARID5 AT-rich motif group.
ATMIN/ASCIZ/ZNF822 is a C2H2-C2HC zinc finger, not a bZIP; the ontology's BZIP_OTHER def naming 'ATMIN-like' looks like an error and should probably be dropped.
DACHbox-N/DD1 adopts a winged-helix fold and DACH1 binds forkhead-like sites in competition with FOXM1, but the domain is a distinct SKI/DAC family (see proposal DACH).
Paralogue of DACH1; same winged-helix/forkhead-like DD1 domain, motif support weaker still.
Basonuclin-2, three paired C2H2 fingers, non-KRAB, no dedicated ontology entry.
Three central Myb-like repeats places it in Myb/SANT, though its CCCG(G/T)ATGT consensus is unlike the MYB MBS YAACKG.
DM-domain paralogue not enumerated in the DMRT def (which lists DMRTC2); grouped by DM domain.
Listed in both HD_K50 and HD_PRD_LIKE defs; assigned to the more specific germline PRD-like group alongside DPRX/LEUTX/TPRX1.

proposals.name: DACH (Dachshund, DD1 winged-helix)
proposals.def: Retinal-determination factors whose DACHbox-N (DD1) domain adopts a winged-helix fold structurally similar to, but evolutionarily distinct from, the forkhead domain; they bind forkhead-like sites and compete with FOXM1 at target promoters. DACH1, DACH2.
proposals.why: DACH1/2 have no ontology entry; FOX is the closest motif match but merging a SKI/DAC-domain pair into the large forkhead family risks polluting it.
